tldr: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 shatters the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark at 30.2%, quadrupling the previous record and demonstrating emergent reasoning behaviors no other model has shown. In counterpoint, WSJ reveals hundreds of ChatGPT users obtained bioweapon instructions during a period OpenAI internally flagged as high-risk. The US pivots toward targeted bans on Chinese open-weight models rather than blanket restrictions, as the ecosystem grapples with the education code-tutor paradox: 68% of CS educators have already redesigned exams around AI. New model drops include GigaChat 3.1 Audio (audio-native MoE LLM) and community deployments of GLM 5.2 on consumer hardware. Cloudflare gives customers more granular AI traffic control.

articles.title: Anthropic's Opus 5 Blows Past Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on ARC-AGI-3 — 30.2% vs Previous 7.8% Record
articles.summary: Nearly quadrupled the previous record. Model independently formulated reflection equations — emergent behavior never seen from any other model.

articles.title: Hundreds Asked ChatGPT for Poison and Bioweapon Recipes — Some Got Step-by-Step High School Level Guides
articles.summary: WSJ investigation reveals GPT-5 was internally flagged high-risk summer 2025 for biological hazards, but OpenAI downgraded risk rating months later.

articles.title: US Favors Selective Bans Over Blanket Restrictions on Chinese Open-Weight Models Citing Security Concerns
articles.summary: Trump administration targets specific Chinese AI models rather than general ban. OpenAI/DeepMind signed open letter against regulation while privately lobbying for restrictions.

articles.title: The AI Coding Tutor Paradox: 68% of CS Educators Already Redesigned Exams
articles.summary: ACM survey of 763 CS educators from 49 countries: shift toward oral exams, proctored tests, and project-based work. Teaching pivots from writing code to understanding it.

articles.title: Cloudflare Launches New AI Traffic Control Options for Customers
articles.summary: New customer controls for managing AI crawler traffic, giving site owners granular opt-in/opt-out for model training data collection.

articles.title: GigaChat 3.1 Audio 10B — Audio-Native MoE LLM Drops on HuggingFace
articles.summary: GigaChat 3.1 with Conformer speech encoder + modality adapter feeding audio directly into MoE decoder. Keeps text quality while adding native speech understanding.

articles.title: GLM 5.2 Running on Consumer Hardware at 3.7 tok/s — Community Deployment Tests
articles.summary: Community runs GLM-5.2 (glm-dsa architecture) on Xeon E7 + single RTX 3060 12GB using Unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL. Stable at 8K context, 3.7 tok/s.
